title: Q-ROOT-declared-live-drift: declared-live-drift keeps recurring: Read the live value on a clock and set it back to the declaration (DECLARED-LIVE-1).
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe declared-live-drift
**Status:** open

Root cause class `declared-live-drift` recurred on 4 days (2026-11-25, 2026-11-26, 2026-11-27, 2026-11-28); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: a fact the repository declares was applied once and never read back against the live system
Guard: `grep:seed/worker/src/declared.js::reconcileVisibility`
Remedy: Read the live value on a clock and set it back to the declaration (DECLARED-LIVE-1).
Symptoms seen:
- failure-audit:seed-autonomous: seed-autonomous a seed was deployed with a database and a cron only: no source-control credential and no repository of i
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe declared-live-drift
